description: This is a test file for integration testing of an API's OpenAPI spec and Swagger UI accessibility. It contains tests that verify the '/openapi.json' endpoint returns a valid OpenAPI specification with specific paths and servers, and that the '/docs' endpoint serves the Swagger UI.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Defines a test case to validate that '/openapi.json' returns a proper OpenAPI spec with populated paths and servers.
